_meta.note: Citation registry for marker reference ranges (appendix-biomarkers + grid + Doc 02 + Male/Female). Keyed by the marker 'source' token in pillars.json. Real guideline references with DOI/PMID; url prefers doi.org (resolves to publisher). 'section' names the table/section where the range lives; 'anchor' = 'document' (DOI only), 'page' (#page=N), or 'fragment' (#:~:text=). NOTE: a few tokens (e.g. WHO) are shared by multiple markers, so the link is the most-likely document — the section text disambiguates. Re-verify before production (README §5.6).
_meta.verified_method: DOIs/PMIDs authored from established guidelines; links to be confirmed live via WebFetch (verified flag).
